bio.text: Thomas P. DiNapoli has been New York State Comptroller since being elected by the State Legislature on February 7, 2007, and was elected by voters in 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022; Ballotpedia lists him on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He represented the 16th Assembly District in northwestern Nassau County for 20 years after being elected in 1986.
In 1972 he was elected a trustee of the Mineola Board of Education; he earned a bachelor's degree in history from Hofstra University in 1976 and a master's degree from The New School.
